selection_policy: Select only on the 60-question E5 development benchmark using correct source+page Recall@5 as the primary objective, with MRR@5, nDCG@5, and identifier-free discovery performance as secondary evidence. Do not tune retrieval after this freeze before the one-time final-test evaluation.

remaining_development_top5_misses.diagnosis: candidate-generation miss; reranking cannot recover evidence absent from the fixed E5-C top-20 pool
near-boundary ranking miss; no further tuning permitted after freeze

retrieval_configuration.reranker_instruction: Given an aviation airworthiness-directive maintenance query, rank passages by how directly and completely they answer the query. Preserve exact applicability, compliance thresholds, timing, exceptions, identifiers, lifecycle statements, and referenced publications.
retrieval_configuration.known_document_route: deterministic exact-identifier routing preserved from E5-A/E5-B
retrieval_configuration.discovery_route: E5-C BM25/Qwen fused document and passage candidate generation followed by E5-D Qwen reranking

lock_rules: Do not tune E5-A, E5-B, E5-C, or E5-D further from development misses after this freeze.
Do not change embedding/reranker models, model revisions, prompts/instructions, candidate limits, RRF settings, chunking, routing, or evidence-assembly behavior before final evaluation.
Freeze hosted-QA provider/model/prompt/evidence-pack settings separately before opening the 40-question final benchmark.
The 16 final-test families and 40 final questions remain sealed until hosted-QA settings are frozen.
Run the frozen final retrieval/QA benchmark once; any later analyses must be clearly labeled post-hoc and must not replace the primary final result.
